objectives.description: Post-transform diff, coverage check, exit 5 refusal
Gate scoping (default target + non-init only), no regression
Header documentation (exit 5, both flags, worked examples)
Fix regressions in pre-existing state-write fixture suites

approaches_tried.approach: Test the gate using --state-file pointing at a scratch fixture
approaches_tried.reason: the gate is deliberately scoped to IS_DEFAULT_TARGET only (archive/vault writes via --state-file must be unaffected), so a --state-file-based test structurally cannot exercise it; switched to a full fake-repo skeleton (mktemp'd .claude/scripts/ + specs/) so the default-target resolution is genuine

approaches_tried.approach: Recording map filter: ($newnums | index(.project_number)) != null inside .active_projects |= map(...)
approaches_tried.reason: jq evaluates index()'s argument expression against index()'s OWN input (the array being piped in), not the map() element -- '.' inside index(EXPR) is $newnums itself, so .project_number tried to index an array by string and errored; fixed by binding .project_number as $pn before the index() call

approaches_tried.approach: Recording map filter: $by_id[.project_name] with no guard
approaches_tried.reason: jq raises 'Cannot index object with null' when the bracket index expression evaluates to null (an entry with no project_name field at all, as two pre-existing test fixtures exercise); fixed with (.project_name // "") before the lookup

approaches_tried.approach: Dry-run audit-gate branch unconditionally calling alloc_issued_number()
approaches_tried.reason: that function's jq call references --allocate-into-only JQ_ARGS bindings (__alloc_archive_raw etc.), which are never added when ALLOCATE_INTO_SET=false; a write with no --allocate-into at all (e.g. Case D/F in test-state-write-large-payload.sh) hit this and failed with an empty error message; fixed by gating that specific call to ALLOCATE_INTO_SET=true only
